correctness.rationale: An exact reflection bijection on all cross-packet pairs proves the conditional binomial inversion law, with disjoint fair tie coins. The derived centered-binomial fourth moment gives mean and variance for every n. Tie-noise variance is O(n), and the binomial CLT yields the reflected chi-square limit on scale n. The independent-binary-label identity for GSR is expanded algebraically into linear and quadratic terms; their variances are n(n^2-1)/48 and n(n-1)/32 with zero covariance, giving the exact variance n(n-1)(2n+5)/96 and Gaussian scale n^(3/2) by Lindeberg. The packaged standard-library checker passed 472 exhaustive exact-arithmetic assertions for the described finite sizes; these tests are not substitutes for proofs.

value.rationale: For two natural interleavers under exactly the same binomial cut distribution and identical inversion mean, midpoint sorting eliminates the leading within-cut stochastic fluctuation. The exact full inversion law and order-n chi-square-type fluctuation limit contrast with cubic variance and an n^(3/2)-Gaussian law under GSR. The sharp ratio 3/(2n+5) on odd decks and all-parity extension make the difference structural, not a tiny numerical gain; no unproved mixing consequence is used to justify value.
